research_question: Can an independent local atomic-claim judge distinguish faithful reflection text from negation, omission, actor, order, and language-surface failures before it is used to attribute V4 errors?

motivation.observed_problem: The V4 preregistered proxy reported perfect rule precision and Japanese surface quality even though direct inspection found a negation reversal, source-external Chinese, an actor ambiguity, and two downstream behavior regressions.
motivation.project_relevance: Without layer-specific semantic fidelity evidence, changing memory extraction, planner consumption, or final realization would be blind patching.

external_method_basis.title: FActScore: Fine-grained Atomic Evaluation of Factual Precision in Long Form Text Generation
external_method_basis.use: Decompose meaning into atomic claims and score each claim against a trusted source.

external_method_basis.title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
external_method_basis.use: Keep evidence retrieval and answer correctness as separate measurements.

external_method_basis.title: Ollama thinking and OpenAI compatibility documentation
external_method_basis.use: Run a local fixed-seed judge with thinking disabled and structured output.

controlled_variables: same judge model and local snapshot
same system prompt and two calibration examples
same temperature, seed, thinking setting, and JSON schema
no runtime memory, planner, right-brain, benchmark answer, or human rating
claim_boundary: Passing validates only this judge on 12 authored calibration candidates. It may support a clearly labeled posthoc V4 layer diagnosis, but cannot validate reflection runtime, general semantic entailment, or broad human likeness.
